name: next
headline: What comes *next*
visualData: One app on every desktop — Windows, macOS and Linux · one protocol · hosts your hive
Source in the hive — read it, change it, try it on your own domain
Scheduled checks — walk your tree and file their reports as tiles
Hives that ask hives — request work, receive results you can verify
say: What comes next. One app for every desktop, Windows, macOS and Linux, held to the same open protocol, and able to host your hive itself. The platform's own source, living in the hive, so anyone can read it, change it, and try the change on their own domain. Scheduled checks that walk your tree, and file their reports as tiles. And hives that can ask each other for work, and receive results they can verify.
